name: webmcp-connector
description: Connect a web page's WebMCP tools (and an embedded chat) to a local Claude Code daemon.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && NODE_ENV=production bun build src/index.ts src/react/index.tsx src/webmcp-global.ts --target=browser --format=esm --splitting --outdir=dist --external react --external react-dom --external react/jsx-runtime --external react-markdown --external remark-gfm --external '@agentclientprotocol/sdk' --external '@agentclientprotocol/sdk/*' && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node ../../scripts/fix-dts-extensions.mjs dist
